backtest_forensics.cost_assumptions: broker Strategy Tester defaults in the active terminal profile
backtest_forensics.ea_identity: existing thin EA entrypoint and common-file model/feature handoff
backtest_forensics.forensic_checks: feature handoff, tester output presence, normalized KPI parser errors, and ledger identity
backtest_forensics.tester_identity: captured in prepared MT5 attempts and strategy tester reports

changed_variables: OOS drift omission for two stress variants
experiment_design.decision_use: Choose what, if anything, is still worth researching inside Stage35.
experiment_design.evidence_plan: run_manifest, kpi_record, normalized KPI packet, stage/project ledgers, report, and strategy tester outputs.
experiment_design.failure_criteria: No variant shows OOS strength, or the clue depends on one fragile month only.
experiment_design.hypothesis: A coarser all-worthwhile sweep can tell which Stage35 clues deserve a later narrow packet.
experiment_design.invalid_conditions: missing feature files, malformed tester report, feature hash mismatch, or incomplete MT5 handoff.
experiment_design.sample_scope: Tier A validation_is and OOS Strategy Tester windows.
experiment_design.stop_conditions: Stop after all planned variants run; no micro tuning inside this packet.
experiment_design.success_criteria: MT5 completed with enough trades and a validation/OOS clue that survives boundary wording.

exploration_design.broad_sweep: 7 session timing variants plus all return-volatility and trend-momentum atlas states.
exploration_design.extreme_sweep: OOS drift stress excludes 2025-10 for one return-volatility state and one trend-momentum state.
exploration_design.failure_memory: Weak or split-inconsistent variants remain negative clues, not dead ideas.
exploration_design.hypothesis: Stage35 useful context may be hidden inside session slices and individual atlas states rather than only the five selected RUN29A topics.
exploration_design.micro_search_gate: Only variants with repeated validation/OOS MT5 strength should move to a separate native-rule or WFO packet.
exploration_design.tier_scope: Tier A runtime probe; Tier B and combined records are out_of_scope_by_claim.
exploration_design.wfo_plan: not WFO; this is a single-window runtime probe and cannot make operating claims.

result_judgment.evidence_available: MT5 KPI records, run manifest, tester reports, normalized KPI packet, and ledgers
result_judgment.evidence_missing: native MT5 clustering, WFO, Tier B/combined runtime rows, and operating parity closure
result_judgment.next_condition: Only a separate narrow packet with stronger parity/WFO can upgrade the clue.
result_judgment.user_explanation_hook: This tells what is still worth looking at, not what is ready to trade.

runtime_inputs.known_runtime_difference: variant masks are precomputed in Python and handed to MT5 by feature-row omission; this is runtime_probe, not native runtime authority.

runtime_parity.parity_check: MT5 Strategy Tester output plus normalized KPI parsing.
runtime_parity.shared_contract: 58-feature order, split windows, constant EBM score table, thresholds, max hold, and row-omission masks.
